The welcome page is a Server Component that records a page view on each request. It uses `connection()` for per-request rendering and schedules the analytics POST with `after()`, so the POST does not delay the response.

Set `ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT` to your service’s event URL; [`.env.example`](/workspace/.env.example) shows the configuration and optional bearer token. The implementation is in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) and [lib/analytics.ts](/workspace/lib/analytics.ts).

The production build passed. In a local check with an analytics endpoint delayed by 1.5 seconds, the page responded in 48 ms and the endpoint received the page-view event.
